Commentary.Commentary: 348 to win. 1-0 India? Well, they will certainly believe so. Stay tuned for the reply.

Poor bowling from the Kiwis. Not because they conceded close to 350. But because they conceded 27 extras. Ouch. 20 of those coming in wides and no balls. They never looked in control of the swing and let India get off to a flier. Then, they managed to exert some control but lost it once Rahul arrived. Everyone took a beating but strangely, Ish Sodhi did not get more than 4 overs.

India were going at just over 5 an over when Kohli fell but Rahul came out and just blazed the Kiwi attack. That infused some energy into Iyer who started to come into his own after a poor start. The duo added 136 for the 4th wicket, in just 105 balls which just took the game away from the Kiwis. Ahh... alright. Never judge a pitch till both sides have played on it. The chase is still to begin. But one believes that this partnership took the momentum away at least. Happy? Kedar Jadhav certainly made Indian fans happy as he played an unbelievable cameo of 26 from just 15 balls.

An innings which started like a runaway train, only to get derailed for a while. India raced to 50 without losing a wicket in the 8th over but then lost both openers in quick time. Virat Kohli and Shreyas Iyer then took control of the reigns, absolutely not fussed about the situation and got a 102-run stand. King Kohli was dismissed but Prince Rahul then arrived and totally changed the complexion of the game.

Commanding. Magnanimous. Huge. Massive. Sure, there will be words to signify large in English but let us stop it at that. From a position where India were looking at PERHAPS 300, they have ALMOST got to 350. 96 in the last 10 overs and the Kiwi bowlers have been killed at the death.
Terrific ball. A swinging yorker, on middle, but equally well played too. KL digs it out towards long on. Just a run. INDIA FINISH ON 347/4!
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a single.

A low full toss, outside off, Rahul looks to slog but the ball takes the inside edge, hits the pads and rolls to the off side. KL Is searching for the ball, looking at the leg side and stops halfway in the pitch. Then, he realizes where the ball is and resumes running. Bennett is not aware what Rahul is doing, else he could have gone for the run out at the bowler's end.
WIDE. This is massively far and Rahul himself signals a wide. Not good as per the match referee's books. Might book an appointment tonight.
Well outside off, KL leaves it. He expects a wide but the umpire does not signal it. Rahul is not happy but replays show that the ball is an off cutter, coming inside the guideline.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
WIDE. Another one way outside off, KJ throws his bat at it but misses again.
A dot ball. On a length, outside off, Kedar plays and misses.
WIDE. Jadhav comes down the track and Bennett bowls it extremely wide. Well outside off.
SIX! That is a terrific shot! A fuller ball outside off, Rahul reverse whips this over short third man and the ball goes all the way! 14 from the over, 34 from the last 2!
On middle, pushed through mid on for a run.
A leg cutter, around middle, Kedar looks to heave but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.
WIDE. A slower bouncer, around middle, Kedar looks to hook but misses.
A short ball, pulled through mid-wicket for a run.
A short ball, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Cover drops back and fine leg comes up.

FOUR! That is just unplayable. Jadhav backs away to the leg side and Neesham follows him. It is a length ball on the pads, cramping him for room but Kedar lofts this inside out. Almost clears the ropes at cover!
James Neesham returns. 7-0-38-0 so far.
FOUR! 20 from the over! Full and outside off, Rahul reaches out and squeezes it behind point!

Full and outside off, Kedar gets across and drives it straight to Mitchell Santner at cover. KJ is disappointed with himself. Indicates to Rahul that he wanted to go straight again as it was in the slot.

FOUR! What a shot. This is a cameo of terrific proportions from Jadhav. 17 from just 7 balls. Full and outside off, Jadhav gets across and slams it down the ground. There is long off and he races to his right but cannot get there!
We have lost the ball...
SIX! CLUBBED! That is a terrific slog. Full and outside off, Jadhav gets down and mows a slog over mid-wicket!
FOUR! Gets it over! Full and wide outside off, Jadhav reaches out and lofts it over cover. The fielder leaps inside the ring but the ball goes over him to the fence behind!
Yorker outside off, Rahul looks to dig it out but the ball goes off the inside edge past the stumps to fine leg. A single taken.
Yorker, following the batsman down the leg side, dug out back to the bowler.
Drives this through mid off for one more.
A short ball, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Outside off, punched off the back foot for a single.
FOUR! Delightful! Rahul gets across his stumps, takes the ball on the full and laps it over short fine leg. Almost gets it over the ropes! Bounces just inside. 300 UP FOR INDIA!
Full and outside off, Jadhav backs away and slaps it through mid off for a single.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot for a single. 7 runs and a wicket from the over. Southee's figures read 9-1-65-2 so far.
Full on middle, pushed through mid on for a single.
FOUR! Off the top edge. India won't care. A length ball, outside off, Rahul looks to slog this out of the park but gets a top edge which flies over the keeper to the third man fence!
Kedar Jadhav walks in at number 6, replacing Iyer.

OUT! Caught! Powerfully hit but straight to the fielder. Full and wide outside off, Iyer reaches out and carves it through the covers. But it is straight to Mitchell Santner at the ropes! Iyer cannot believe his luck. He trudges off but it has been one kind of an innings. Poor start but terrific acceleration.
Slower ball, fuller in length, wide outside off, Shreyas gets across and swings hard but does not connect.
Full and wide outside off, Rahul slices it straight to Ross Taylor at point. A meter here and there and it would have been a boundary. A single taken.
Tim Southee is back on. 8-1-58-1 so far.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single. Great over from Bennett - just 6 from it.
Excellent running. Down the leg side, Rahul whips this through mid-wicket, calls for two and comes back running hard.
Change of bats for KL Rahul.
That is a full toss, on the pads, Iyer flicks it in the air and the ball nearly carries to deep mid-wicket. Falls just short of Tom Blundell running in. A run taken.
Excellent bowling. Bennett sees Iyer back away down the leg side and fires a yorker on the stumps. Shreyas just about manages to dig it back.
Full and straight, hit down the ground for a single.
Works this down the leg side for a single.
Hamish Bennett back at the death. Tough evening for him so far. 7-0-56-0 so far.
SIX! Beautiful hands! A full toss, around off, Rahul just swings with ease and the ball flies over mid-wicket! Would have been a terrific over for New Zealand but this big hit spoils it.
Full and wide outside off, driven straight to cover.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. One run added to the total.
Outside off, punched through the covers for a run.

That is a leeway for the bowler. A length ball, outside off, Rahul lets it go, thinking it will be a wide. But the umpire stays put. KL asks the umpire as to why is it not signalled a wide. But gets no favours. Replays show that the ball did go past the wide guideline.
Full and outside off, left alone.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
MAIDEN ODI CENTURY FOR IYER! It has not been a gem of an innings. Yes, it has not been. He struggled at the start but then has accelerated. Full and outside off, driven through mid off for one more.
The batsman has been hit on the pads as he tried to sweep that one. One run added to the total. The umpire signals a leg bye.
Tossed up outside off, eased through the covers for one.
Full and on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a run. Wow. And just like that, he has reached his half century as well!
WIDE. Down the leg side, Rahul looks to flick but misses.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. They manage to come back for the second.
Wide outside off, left alone.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a run.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. They pick up a single.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a couple.
FOUR! Full and outside off, Iyer throws his bat at it and gets a thick outside edge through the third man region. Past the man at short third man.
James Neesham is back on. 5-0-20-0 so far.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Short and outside off, slapped through backward point for a boundary! The 100-RUN STAND IS UP AS WELL!
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a run.
DROPPED! That should have been taken. Full and outside off, Iyer lofts this down to long off. Colin de Grandhomme gets across for a sitter but cannot hang on! Costly. Shocker. A single taken.
Full on middle, pushed through mid on for a run.
Short and outside off, cut through point. The fielder races to his left and slides but fumbles. Two runs taken.
POWERPLAY 3 time. 5 fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle.
Landed outside off, dabbed to short third man.
Short and outside off, cut through point for a run.
Full on middle, pushed through mid on for a single.
FOUR! Majestic shot. A length ball, outside off, Iyer lofts it beautifully over covers for a boundary!
WIDE. Landed outside off, left alone.
Running repairs for Shreyas Iyer. The left elbow is causing him problems. The physio comes out again.
FOUR! Cheeky! A short ball, outside off, Iyer arches back and deftly guides it over the keeper to the fence behind!

FOUR! Beautifully whipped away! Yes, two contrasting adjectives but we need to use those. Full and on middle, Iyer plays a beautiful whip. But the timing is exquisite and the ball races to the mid-wicket fence.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Full and around middle, watchfully blocked out.
Arrowed on the pads, worked straight to short mid-wicket.
Fractionally short, outside off, cut to point for a run.
Floated around middle, eased down to long off for a single.
Short and outside off, punched straight to point.
A length ball again, slower in pace, tucked through square leg for a run. 14 from the over, 27 from the last 2!
SIX! CLOBBERED! A length ball, outside off, Rahul swings it over mid-wicket for half a dozen!
SIX! High and handsome! A length ball, outside off, Rahul comes forward, leans into this one and lofts it over long off!
Played to the point region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Full and around middle, pushed towards mid on.
Around off, punched towards point.
Tim Southee is back on. 6-1-29-1 so far.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Full and down the leg side, flicked through mid-wicket for three.
FIVE WIDES! Down the leg side, Rahul misses his sweep and the ball goes past the keeper to the fine leg fence.
Landed outside off, dabbed to third man for a single.
The batsman appears to have been struck on the thigh pad. The batsmen have run through for a single. Leg bye given by the umpire.
Full on middle, pushed through mid on for a run.
Short and outside off, cut through point for a single.
Mitchell Santner returns. 6-0-29-0 so far.
A bouncer now on middle, Shreyas ducks.
A length ball, outside off, Iyer looks to play the upper cut but misses.
SIX! Up and over! Both the batsmen are teeing off here. Full and around middle, Iyer comes down the track and lofts it over long on! The 50-run stand is up now.
WIDE. A bouncer now, a bit too high, ducked under.
Around off, defended watchfully.
Full and outside off, played through point for a single.
Around off, defended back to the bowler.
A slight interruption. The physio is out in the middle. Iyer is having his left forearm tended to.
Landed outside off, played straight to point.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Full and around middle, whipped back to the bowler.
SIX! Consecutive maximums! Floated on middle, Rahul swings this over long on and gets another biggie!
SIX! Is this the time to change gears? India certainly feel so. Full and outside off, Rahul comes down the track and lofts it as clean as a whistle over long off!
Full on middle, pushed through mid on for a single.
Full and outside off, Shreyas eases it through the covers. The ball is stopped, thanks to a dive from the man sweeping the ball to his right at the boundary. Three runs taken.
FOUR! That will be a boundary. Short and outside off, Iyer throws the bat at it and gets a bit of an outside edge. The ball races to the third man fence.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Full and straight, pushed towards mid on.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to mid off.
Short and wide outside off, slapped through the covers for a single.
Hamish Bennett to start the first over after the second Drinks break. 5-0-40-0 so far.

DRINKS BREAK. India cruising through. They lost their way a little bit after a quickfire start but Kohli and Iyer got the innings back on track. 17 overs left and with hitters to come, they will aim for at least 300 from here. Possibly more, if a set batsman stays till the end.
Pushed through quicker outside off, watchfully kept out.
Full again, floated outside off, pushed through mid off for one more.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for another single.
Floated outside off, eased through the covers for one more.

HALF CENTURY FOR SHREYAS IYER. Short and outside off, Iyer rocks back and cuts it through the covers for a run. Did not look settled early on but has matured with time. With Kohli not around, Iyer will aim to bat through till the end of the innings. Might perhaps change gears too.
Googly, on middle, Rahul leans and flicks this through mid-wicket for a single.
Short and outside off, Rahul slaps it through the covers for one more. A dot, followed by 5 singles.
A short ball, around middle, punched down to long on for another single.
Action replay of the previous delivery as Rahul does what his partner does. Punch through mid-wicket for one.
A touch short, arrowed on the pads, worked through mid-wicket for a run again.
Full on middle, pushed through mid on for a single.
Around off, blocked from the crease.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for one more.
Down the leg side, worked through mid-wicket for a run.
Full and outside off, eased down to long off for a single.
Short and outside off, real hit-me ball, Iyer cuts but finds sweeper cover. Just a run taken.
Down the leg side, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Fine way to end the over. Short and outside off, Iyer rocks back and cuts it to the right of short third man for a boundary!
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a run.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Around off, watchfully defended.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Short and outside off, punched off the back foot.
KL Rahul walks in at number 5, replacing his skipper.

OUT! BOWLED! Done in by the googly. This is outside off, Kohli lunges to defend but does not pick the wrong 'un. There is a bit of a gap between bat and pad and the ball goes through the gap and hits the leg stump. Kohli looks stunned. Most batsmen do, when they get beaten. Kuldeep would be licking his lips.
Full on middle, pushed through mid on for a single.
Short and outside off, cut through the covers for a couple. 100-RUN STAND IS UP! The pair will now look to accelerate.
Short and outside off, punched back to the bowler.
Ish Sodhi into the attack now. Pretty late, eh?
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for one more.
Full and outside off, Iyer goes on the back foot and mistimes his punch back to the bowler.
Tossed up again, eased through the covers for one more.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a run.
58TH ODI 50 FOR KOHLI! Full on middle, pushed through mid on for a single.
Landed outside off, played straight to point.

FOUR! Slashed away. Short and wide outside off, Iyer lashes out the cut and gets a thick outside edge. There is third man and he moves to his left but cannot get there. 10 from the over, Bennett has gone for 40 in his 5 overs.
Landed outside off, a touch short, extra bounce, Kohli rides the bounce and guides it behind point for a single.
Fullish, around middle, pushed towards mid on.
WIDE. A slower bouncer, around middle, Kohli ducks.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
FOUR! PRISTINE! That is simply gorgeous. Half volley outside off, Kohli leans and drives it through the covers.
Short and around off, punched towards cover.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery. They pick up a single.
The batsman works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a run.
This is flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
Down the leg side, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Landed outside off, Iyer throws his bat at it but misses.
A short ball, outside off, punched off the back foot.
Landed outside off again, tapped through cover for a quick one.
Landed outside off, played through point for a run.
Landed outside off, played through point for a single.
WIDE. A short ball, outside off, Kohli throws his bat at it but misses.
On a length ball outside off, left alone.
Hamish Bennett returns. 3-0-26-0 so far.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a run.
Around off, defended watchfully.
Outside off, played through the covers for a single.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Graceful shot. Full and outside off, Kohli leans and drives it through the covers for a boundary!
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.
FOUR! Wow. That almost seemed a half pull. A length ball, Kohli just whips it through mid on!
On middle and leg, worked through mid-wicket for a run.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Flicks this through mid-wicket for a couple.
Landed outside off, left alone.
Around off, watchfully tapped away for a run.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. One run added to the total.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Down the leg side, Kohli looks to work it to the leg side but closes his bat-face a touch early. The ball goes to cover.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Spin time. Mitchell Santner into the attack now.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
FOUR! Cracking shot. Short and wide outside off, Iyer slaps it through point and gets a boundary!
Around off, defended watchfully.
This time he connects with the pull and gets a single.
A short ball, outside off, Kohli looks to pull but misses.
A length ball, around off, Iyer looks to work it straight but the ball takes the inner half of the bat and goes to deep mid-wicket. A single taken.
The batsman has played it to the point region for a single.
A short ball, outside off, Shreyas backs away and carves it over point. Two runs taken.
A good length ball outside off, watchfully defended.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
FOUR LEG BYES. Down the leg side, Iyer looks to flick but the ball goes off his pads to the fine leg fence. 50-RUN STAND IS UP AS WELL.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a single. 100 UP FOR INDIA. Continue to go at a pretty decent rate.

DROPPED, FOUR! That is twice in 7 balls for Iyer. He is riding his luck. Full and outside off, Shreyas looks to go over mid off but the ball hits the toe end of his bat. It is skewed towards mid off where Tim Southee leaps and gets a hand to it but cannot hold on. The ball races away to the long off fence.
Outside off, guided to point.
A short ball, pulled through mid-wicket for a couple.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Full and outside off, left alone.
A length ball, outside off, pushed straight to point.
DROPPED! Tough chance for Ross Taylor. Full and wide outside off, Iyer looks to drive but the ball takes the outside edge. Taylor at short third man dives to his right but cannot hang on.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
WIDE. 5th of the innings already. Full and down the leg side, Kohli walks across and looks to flick but misses.
Another slower one, fuller in length outside off, watchfully shouldered arms to.
A slower ball, outside off, Shreyas walks down the track but then lets it go.
Full and wide outside off, the skipper reaches out and drives it to sweeper cover for one.
Iyer follows suit now, dabbing it to third man for a run.
Just an example of how late he plays the ball. Kohli waits for the ball to come to him and guides it towards third man for a single.

FOUR! MARVELLOUS! Half volley outside off, Kohli leans and drives it through the covers. Short extra cover dives to his left but the ball whizzes past him. The stand moves to 33 in 45 balls. The skipper moves to 22 from 30 deliveries.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Short and outside off, cut through point for a run.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Outside off, punched through the covers for a single.
Full and outside off, Virat looks to flick but the ball nips in, takes the inside edge and hits him on the right thigh. The skipper limps in pain.

Hits the pitch hard, generates extra bounce, lands it outside off. Kohli reaches out, looking to push it through the covers but the extra bounce makes the ball hit the splice of the bat and go off the inner half of the bat towards mid on.
WIDE. Good pace but misdirected. At 137 kph, Neesham is targetting the leg stump but the swing and angle takes it down the leg side, beating Kohli's attempted flick.
Played to the point region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full and outside off, swinging away, pushed watchfully through the covers for one.

WIDE. Iyer is standing with his leg and middle stumps exposed and seeing that, de Grandhomme targets the leg stump. But the swing takes the ball past the leg stump and Shreyas misses his flick. A wide signalled.
Around off, Shreyas taps it towards mid on and sets off for a quick single but Kohli straightaway sends him back. Would have been a suicidal run.
FOUR! MAJESTIC! A full ball wide outside off, Iyer reaches out and drives it through the covers. Finds the gap and gets his first boundary.
A length ball outside off, delivered with a wobbly seam, left alone.
A length ball, around off, the skipper taps it with soft hands towards mid on and takes a quick single.
WIDE. Down the leg side, Kohli misses his flick.
AARGH! Kohli yells. Because this was a short and wide delivery outside off. He threw his bat at it but could only get it down to third man for a single.
FOUR! A full toss, outside off, Kohli drives this down the ground. Mid off dives to his right but the ball is past him in a flash.
FREE HIT TIME. This is a good opportunity for India to break the shackles.

NO BALL! Did Kohli hear the call early? Perhaps. Because he was straightaway down the track, looking to hit. Neesham tried to bowl it on the pads but misfired it down the leg side. Replays show that his foot landed on the line.

OFF THE MARK ON THE 10TH BALL. Full and outside off, Iyer drives this through the covers. Tim Southee dives to his right at short extra and gets a hand to it. Parries it to the left of mid off and Shreyas gets off the mark with a single.

MISFIELD. Full and outside off, Virat punches it straight to point. But Martin Guptill charging in to stop the ball gets into too much of a hurry and takes his eyes off the ball. It goes off his palms towards third man. A single taken.
Slightly wide outside off, fuller in length, the skipper looks to play away from his body but misses.
Full and around off, Kohli looks to work it to the leg side but he ball straightens, takes the leading edge and goes to mid off.
Another play and a miss. A length ball outside off, Iyer looks to defend but the ball seams away and beats the outside edge.
Ahhh... nearly nicks this one. A length ball, outside off, Iyer reaches out to play at that, away from his body and almost gets an outside edge behind. Is beaten.
Around middle, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
A length ball outside  off, going away again, steered down to third man for a single.
A length ball, outside off, moving away, solidly defended.
Full and outside off, played straight to point.
Switch of ends for Colin de Grandhomme. Just a little use of the wind and trying to take the ball away from the right-handers. 2-0-4-1 so far.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover. A run from Neesham's first.
Around off, tight line, watchfully defended.

ALMOST A WICKET! Would have been another soft dismissal. A length ball, on middle, VK walks across and flicks it. Hits it too well for his liking and the ball is aerial and nearly straight down the throat of Ish Sodhi at deep backward square leg. Lands short. A run taken.
Slipped our mind but Powerplay 2 was signalled after the 10th over. 4 fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.
Full and outside off, driven towards mid off.
This one swings in now. The skipper pushes it towards mid on who is pretty deep. The timing is exquisite and the ball goes pretty quickly. Hence, the single is not taken.
Hint of outswing, outside off, Kohli walks into the shot and drives it to cover.
Jimmy Neesham to bowl now. If the ball continues to swing, he will be a handful.
Around off, tapped through mid-wicket for a quick run.

Still Southee is getting some swing. He gets it into the batsman, the skipper is tight in defense but because of the late swing, the bat turns in his hands and the ball hits the inner half of his bat and drops it down.
Outside off, driven beautifully but straight to wide mid off.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
A length ball, 6 inches outside off, Virat walks into the shot and then confidently leaves it alone.
FOUR! BRUTAL! A short ball, outside off, Kohli, not the one to miss out on any scoring opportunity. Pulls it with disdain over mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off. 55/2 IN POWERPLAY 1 for India. Good end to the phase for the Kiwis.
Fuller and around off, well defended.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Around off, blocked from the crease.
The batsman fails to get bat on that one and is hit on the pad.
A length ball, outside off, pushed towards point.
A length ball, around off, Shreyas looks to defend but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.
Full and around off, Iyer drives it straight back, only to see it get stopped.
Shreyas Iyer comes out to the middle. Two new batsmen at the crease.

OUT! CAUGHT! Straight to the man. Agarwal goes too! Two wickets for New Zealand in the span of 5 balls. Not a wicket-taking delivery by any means. Short and outside off, Agarwal throws his bat at it and cuts really hard. But to his hard luck, he finds Tom Blundell at point to perfection. Mayank is in utter dismay. That was a boundary ball. Instead, it turns out to be a wicket delivery. So both the new openers, after looking good, throw their wickets away.
Outside off, left alone.
FOUR! A short ball, around off, Agarwal pulls it over mi-wicket and gets a boundary.
A bouncer on middle, Agarwal ducks.
In comes the skipper, Virat Kohli.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! De Grandhomme strikes in his very first over. A length ball, outside off, nipping away, Shaw looks to run it down to third man but only manages to nick it behind. First strike for the Kiwis. Shaw looked good in his brief stay.
50-RUN OPENING STAND IS UP! This is a solid beginning for India. A length ball outside off, Mayank runs it down to third man and gets a single.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
One more leave outside off.
Landed outside off, left alone.
WIDE. A length ball, pretty wide outside off, Agarwal stays leg side of the ball and chases it, going at it flat-footed but misses.
A length ball, around off, Shaw flicks it uppishly, but wide of mid on for a single.
Swing on offer. So Colin de Grandhomme comes on as the first change.
A good length ball outside off, nice line, left alone to end a 10-run over.
Down the leg side, flicked through mid-wicket for a couple.
Fuller and around off, watchfully defended.
FOUR! BOSH! Short and wide outside off, Agarwal slaps it over point for a boundary!
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
FOUR! EDGED AWAY! A length ball, outside off, Agarwal looks to defend but the ball moves away and squares him up. Takes the outside edge but evades second slip and goes to the third man fence.
Outside off, punched sweetly but straight to cover.
Down the leg side, Prithvi flicks it through mid-wicket where Neesham gets a hand on it and slows it down. Mid on gets to the ball and keeps the batsmen to a couple.
FOUR! BOOM! A short ball, around middle, Shaw pulls it over mid-wicket and gets a boundary!
Outside off, dabbed to third man for a single.
A length ball, around off, coming in, Mayank looks to tuck but misses and is hit on the pads. Bennett puts in a half-appeal but no one from his own team is even interested.
FOUR! Down the leg side, Agarwal tickles it to the fine leg fence.
Works this wide of mid on for a quick single. There is a shy at the bowler's end but it misses the stumps. Could have been touch and go.
FOUR! MAGNIFICENT! Half volley, outside off, Agarwal leans and drives it through the covers!

NOT OUT. UMPIRE'S CALL! A length ball, around off, Agarwal looks to defend but the ball skids off the deck and hits him on the pads. Southee appeals but the umpire moves away. The bowler immediately asks his keeper who opines that bat might be involved. But Southee is firm that there is no inside edge. Latham then takes the review immediately. Hot Spot proves Southee right but then Ball Tracker arrives, it shows the ball to be clipping the top of the bails. Agarwal survives.
LBW review! Is that bat first? Southee is confident that it is not bat first. Replays confirm that. Nothing on Hot Spot. Will height be an issue? Umpire's call on height!
Believe it or not, we are going to have an 8-1 off side field. Nope. 7-2. No third man. He moves to short mid-wicket.
Outside off, left alone.
Another play and a miss. A length ball, around off, Mayank is squared up again, looking to defend. Beaten once more.
That is a jaffa. On a length outside off, Agarwal walks down the track, looks to defend but the ball moves away and squares him up.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! A length ball, outside off, Shaw gets on top of the bounce and punches it through the covers!
FOUR! Beautifully done. Full and around middle, Shaw flicks it through mid-wicket, finds the gap and the fence.
Short and outside off, cut behind point for a run.
Driven towards the mid on region. They pick up a single.
Full and on middle, driven beautifully but straight to mid on.
A length ball, around middle, Shaw looks to tuck it to the leg side but misses and is hit on the pads.
A leave outside off to end the over.
Full on middle, pushed towards mid on.
Full and outside off, let through once again.
Landed outside off, left alone.
FOUR! LOVELY! Overpitched, outside off, Agarwal comes forward, gets to the pitch of the ball and drives this through mid off!

Landed outside off, Shaw punches it through point. The man from point, Jimmy Neesham dives to his right, makes a half-stop while cover-point dives to his left and makes a half-stop as well. A single taken.
Too short and too wide outside off, opportunity for runs and Agarwal does not miss out. Punches it through the covers and gets a couple.
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side. They pick up a single.

FIRST RUNS OFF THE BAT. A short ball, outside off, Shaw punches it through the covers. The outfield is not the quickest and Tim Southee gets to it from mid off. Two runs taken. Those are the first, of many, for Shaw in ODI cricket.
Full and outside off, swinging in, pushed towards cover.
Landed outside off, played straight to point.
A length ball, down the leg side, Agarwal looks to tuck but misses. The ball goes off his pads towards fine leg. A leg bye taken.
Hamish Bennett to bowl with the second new ball.
Landed around off, watchfully defended. A MAIDEN TO START OFF PROCEEDINGS.
Fuller and around off, Shaw looks to defend but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.
Nice curve, fuller in length, swinging away, Prithvi defends it back to the bowler.
A length ball, outside off, Prithvi looks to tuck it to the leg side but gets a thick inside edge onto his hip.
Swing on offer. Full and outside off, swinging away, left alone.
A length ball outside off, moving away, punched sweetly, off the middle of the bat, but straight to cover.

We are all set to begin! The two new openers for India, Mayank Agarwal and Prithvi Shaw make their way out to the middle. The Kiwi players are in a huddle before they take their respective positions in the field. Tim Southee to start off proceedings. Shaw to face. Here we go...
Both teams are out on the field for the respective National Anthems.

PITCH REPORT - Scott Styris says that the soil used is the Mohali soil. VVS Laxman observes that there is no grass cover as the batting of New Zealand is not that strong. Believes that it is a good pitch to bat on and might aid spin later on in the innings. Styris adds that the pitch looks a bit tacky, so the ball might stick on the surface initially but then should come onto the bat as the game goes on.

New Zealand (Playing XI) - Martin Guptill, Henry Nicholls, Tom Latham(C AND WK), Tom Blundell, Ross Taylor, Jimmy Neesham, Colin de Grandhomme, Mitchell Santner, Tim Southee, Ish Sodhi and Hamish Bennett.
India (Playing XI) - Prithvi Shaw, Mayank Agarwal, Virat Kohli(C), Shreyas Iyer, KL Rahul(WK), Kedar Jadhav, Ravindra Jadeja, Shardul Thakur, Mohammed Shami, Kuldeep Yadav and Jasprit Bumrah.

Indian captain, Virat Kohli too, admits he would have bowled first, as it is a short ground and under lights, batting gets easier. But is now looking to bat well, especially in the absence of Rohit Sharma. Is super excited to see a new opening combination in Prithvi Shaw and Mayank Agarwal. Informs that Manish Pandey, Rishabh Pant, Shivam Dube, Navdeep Saini and Yuzvendra Chahal are the 5 guys missing out from the squad. Believes that Kuldeep Yadav's variety tips him ahead of Chahal. Feels that at home, they can be dominant as anyone but it is foreign conditions which will test them. Hence, he believes that a 5-0 win in the T20Is puts them in really good perspective. Adds that since this year has a major focus on T20Is, one would see plenty of new faces being tried out in the ODIs.

New Zealand skipper, Tom Latham, says that the reason is due to history where chasing is favoured in the ground as it becomes difficult to defend under lights. Informs Neesham and de Grandhomme are the all-rounders while the seam attack comprises of Tim Southee and Hamish Bennett. Further says that Mitchell Santner and Ish Sodhi would be their spinners. On being asked whether they could take confidence from an ODI which was played as long as 5 months ago, Latham is confident that they can maintain their good run.
TOSS - Latham flips is the coin, Heads is the call from Kohli but it is a Tail. NEW ZEALAND ELECT TO CHASE.
Prithvi Shaw and Mayanak Agarwal are being handed their ODI caps. Good luck to them!
WEATHER - For starters, it is a bright and sunny afternoon in Hamilton. No threat of rain.

New Zealand, on the other hand, are returning to the format post their dramatic World Cup loss against England. They were in a thumping form during the tournament, but here with a few key players from that team missing, they will look to trouble the Indians and make amends to their whitewash in the T20I series. Stay with us to find out how things pan out.

After a thumping victory over the hosts in the 5-match T20I series, the caravan moves to 50-over format. By the looks of things, one can say the story in this format won't be a lot different. Both the teams are marred with injuries to their one of the star players - Rohit Sharma for India and regular skipper Kane Williamson for New Zealand. India are set to hand debuts to Prithvi Shaw and Mayank Agarwal and it will be interesting to see if these prospects shine for the Indians and show their strengthened bench strength in this format.
